Hi Jules / Samir —

Thanks again for taking time today. Quick recap from our discovery: FinOpsCorp is focused on reducing inference spend for your customer-facing product while keeping latency under your 150ms target. We discussed a 6–8 week evaluation (pilot) running a representative workload against our Dedicated runtime plus a short integration to verify KV cache behavior.

I attached a first-pass Mutual Action Plan (FinOps_Mutual_Action_Plan_v1.1.pdf) with proposed owners and target dates. Quick asks:
- Can you confirm who at FinOpsCorp will be the MAP owner (contract & procurement touchpoint) and who will own the evaluation (technical lead)?
- Are the milestone dates reasonable (pilot start: 2028-03-22, review: 2028-04-05)?

If the dates aren’t right, tell me the window and we’ll adapt — happy to shift the pilot start or split milestones. If it helps, I can loop in an SRE from our side for a short tech sync next week.

Next step I propose: 30-min sync the week of Mar 20 to lock owners and ask any procurement questions. If you prefer, reply with owners/dates and we’ll update the MAP and send a revised copy.

Thanks — appreciate this.

— Laura Bennett
